image_description: A close-up shot of a green snake, identified as a green mamba, draped over green foliage. The snake has a slender body with bright green scales on the dorsal side and a pale/white ventral side. Distinct black cross-hatching or net-like patterns are visible on the scales along the flank. The head is elongated with a visible eye.
